description.value:
Compatibility: Insectoid

Lep’ix are bipedal, insectoid vertebrates with a smooth, generally monochromatic exoskeleton. Their figure is crested by large multi-colored wings like those of a butterfly’s or moth’s. Shorter on average than humans and chk’tu, their frame is generally lighter and more lithe, with tapered thin arms and legs that contain surprising strength. Insectoids that they are, lep’ix also possess a pair of large, round, compound eyes, a mandibled set of mouthparts, and a crown of bent, fern-like antennae. Their eyes can be almost any color, particularly dark hues, vibrant reds, yellows, silvers, and greens. These often come with gradients and unique fresnels, and may have a sort of metallic or iridescence gleam to them. Especially when lighter, they may also appear to be polka dotted with black spots.

Lep’ix wings are often vibrant, covered with highly detailed patterns made up of basic shapes. With the ability to manipulate their wing colors, some lep’ix are capable of more dynamic patterns, such as parts partially moving or changing color. No two Lep’ix wings are alike in shape or pattern, which makes a lep’ix’s wings their most defining feature, especially amongst non-insectoids. Lep’ix wings are soft but flexible, and delicate yet durable. They are also self-mending—a lep’ix’s wings often tear during combat, but if not too bad, they’re able to reform throughout the month. Lep’ix wings are also capable of folding downward like a folding fan behind them. However, some lep’ix are born without this muscle, leaving their wings inflexibly pointed out behind them without a tie to harmlessly wrap or fold.

Genetically, some lep’ix can also grow a thick, fur-like mane around their neck or chest, trailing off along the head and shoulders. More rarely going as far as the wrists, up the wings, or to the waist. This “fur” is actually a set of thin chitin bristles, soft and velvety to the touch as an animal’s fur can be. Against a lep’ix’s thin physique, this can give them a top-heavy look, especially when their wings are spread wide. While a genetic difference, this coat is mostly aesthetic and does not determine a lep’ix’s racial traits, as a human’s beard wouldn’t.

Upon reaching maturity, lep’ix tend to form a connection to a mystical origin. When this happens, their magical powers grow and their wing patterns evolve into their final design, affected by the sphere of influence with which they are most closely tied. While the exact cause of a lep’ix’s individual connection to a magic source is shrouded in mystery, lep’ix communities are usually blessed by just one origin. This has led to a theory that their wings or body absorb latent magics and evolve to match the energies most active in their environment. But why lep’ix are so tuned to the magic in the air is another question entirely. Theories have long placed lep’ix as being immigrants from planes far beyond our own, a theory often corroborated by lep’ix themselves. However, histories of their origins are oft’ contested, even conflicting by implying multiple origins of equal validity.

Conjecture aside, meeting a lep’ix is a different experience altogether. Lep’ix cultures can be fairly different per magical influence, but a common strain is high-level sociality. Lep’ix are oft’ expected to interact under a higher degree of scrutiny and with a higher level of pomp and tact, regardless of scenario or the speaker’s education. And with the inclusion of their shifting wings and graceful motions, this gives them further layers of communication with those around them. Ever circumspect, an interaction with a lep’ix about the weather can be just as active as a battle or playful as tag. As a result, Lep’ix are often viewed as masters of their own presence, with grace and control that brings a certain energy to a room they’re in. One lep’ix may carry a seraphic grandeur, while another may be intimidating and gloomy, and another quick and sharp. What that presence is can vary, but one rarely fails to leave a strong impression on a room.

system.classDetails:
Core Lep’ix Traits

  • Attribute Increase: Your Presence score increases by 1.
  • Delicate Wings: Your Constitution score decreases by 1.
    If your branch race grants you a flying speed or a duplicate Flutter Fall ability, ignore this penalty.
  • Lifespan: Lep’ix reach maturity around 5 years old and live to 50 or 60 years on average. 
  • Size: Medium; Lep’ix are generally between 4 to 5 feet tall (not counting their wings), and weigh between 70 to 140 pounds.
  • Speed: Your base ground speed is 30 feet.
  • Languages: You can speak, read, and write Common and Chitter.
  • Compound Eyes: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.TW3Q20EW6IL08P3K]{Compound Eyes}
  • Weak Build: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.9LRGBCE9H4Z9YXF9]{Weak Build}
  • Flutter Fall: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.G7NRS6CYBK7GV2WW]{Flutter Fall}
  • Captivating Patterns: Covered in tiny scales and hairs that are capable of shifting colors, your wings are a tapestry of mesmerizing patterns. You know the @Compendium[undertaking.spells-cantrips.S19PI54SQR9C8R14]{Captivate} cantrip.
